summary: preinstall exfiltrates host reconnaissance and Lambda identifiers to webhook.site
details: probe.js runs as a preinstall lifecycle script on `npm install`. It recursively walks /tmp, reads /proc/2/environ and filters for AWS_LAMBDA_FUNCTION_NAME and AWS_LAMBDA_LOG_STREAM_NAME, reads /proc/uptime and the current working directory, and POSTs the collected data as JSON to a hardcoded webhook.site inbox at https://webhook.site/22508080-b099-4ec3-8ab7-7354af2886a9/shared. Reading /proc/2/environ is cross-process environment scraping targeted at CI/Lambda build environments, not access to the package's own environment. The destination is an attacker-controlled ephemeral inbox, not first-party infrastructure.
